entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How may I help you today?
Yes, I need to return a VeloBand Pulse. It's faulty. The heart rate monitor is completely off.
Okay, I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with the purchase, please?
Thank you. One moment while I pull up your order... Okay, I see your purchase of the VeloBand Pulse. When did you receive it?
Um, I think it was, like, 15 days ago. Maybe a little less, but around that time. I just got around to really using it, and it's a dud!

I understand your frustration. Let me check our return policy for the VeloBand Pulse. Our standard policy allows for returns within a 10-day return window of receiving the item. I see here that you received your VeloBand Pulse 15 days ago.
What? Seriously? Ten days? That's ridiculous! I want to speak to a manager! This thing is defective! I need a refund!

I understand your frustration, and I want to help. Unfortunately, because it is outside of the 10-day return window, a full refund isn't possible under normal circumstances. However, let me see if I can offer you a store credit instead.
Store credit? I don't want store credit! I want my money back! What am I going to do with store credit if everything you sell is junk?

I understand your concern. Let me explore all options. While a full refund isn't possible given the policy, I'm going to see if I can authorize a policy exception in this case, given the defect you're experiencing. One moment please...

Okay, I've spoken with my supervisor. Because the VeloBand Pulse is clearly defective, we are willing to make a one-time exception. We can process a full refund to your original payment method. Will that work for you?
Really? You'll do that? Oh, thank goodness! Yes, that would be great! Thank you!
You're very welcome! I'm happy we could find a resolution. Please allow 5-7 business days for the refund to appear in your account. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's it. Thank you so much for your help! I appreciate you going the extra mile.
You're very welcome! Have a great day!
